title: Class balance of the seam link
one_line: The class balance <A> of one seam link, measured as a ratio of partition functions with one centre-twisted link step.
map_into_this_step: defects to field: the class-3 flip of one seam is the centre shift of its link; its expectation sets v = E_cell b <A>

conventions.S: 2 pi/(4 alpha) = (pi/2) x, the Gaussian cost of a half turn
conventions.count: 4/c, defined by <A> proportional to exp(-2 pi/(count alpha))
conventions.reading_electric_step: A at the midpoint of the electric step: one twisted time-like plaquette of the seam
conventions.reading_face_step: A at the midpoint of the face step: that plaquette twisted and the faces of the seam half twisted

fields.series[].points[]: x = 1/alpha, S, lnA = ln <A>, err = one standard error (jackknife, 20 blocks per stage)
fields.series[].fit: the adopted fit of ln <A> = ln M0 + p ln S - c S over beta >= 4: p = 1 unless its chi2/dof exceeds 4, then p free; count = 4/c
fields.series[].c_predicted: 1 - Pi of the Cartan circle (heat kernel) or the classical minimum of the twisted Wilson action over 2 pi^2
fields.series[].M_at_x_U_with_predicted_c: multiplicity at the chain coupling: <A>(S_U) exp(c S_U) with c at its prediction
fields.series[].sector_law: weight power w and heat time t of p_n proportional to n^w exp(-t (n^2-1)/4), measured at the chain coupling; tau = g^2/2
fields.series[].candidates: preregistered candidate values of c with the deviation of the fit
fields.exact_counts[]: Cartan circle with the Villain weight: c = 1 - Pi, count = 4/c, <A> at the chain coupling
fields.one_register[]: exact laws of a single register for weight powers 0, 1, 2 and the Cartan circle, against x
fields.flux_density_statements[]: the flux-density statements behind the counts 8/d and the pair weight, with their status here
fields.doublet[]: gauge-Higgs system (compact form), ln <A> on both sides of the Higgs line
fields.second_reading[]: the same measurement with A at the midpoint of the face step
fields.clock: exact Gaussian coefficient c against the number of electric steps per tick, both readings, three spaces
fields.statements[]: text, label (EXACT, MEASURED, ARGUED, IMPORTED, DECLARED), status (derived, one premise, declared, imported, open)
fields.comparison_not_blind: v = E_cell exp(-c S_U) for b M = 1 and v = E_cell <A>(S_U) for b = 1 against 246.22 GeV (PDG 2024). NOT BLIND.

flux_density_statements.statement: On the icosahedral surface one seam flip creates the pair (+2 pi, -2 pi) on its two faces with the square of the one-face weight.
flux_density_statements.status_here: reproduced as a statement about flux densities
flux_density_statements.label: EXACT

flux_density_statements.statement: On cubic complexes the plaquette variance is 2 g^2/d and the count becomes 8/d.
flux_density_statements.status_here: reproduced as the density of the plaquette flux at 2 pi. The class balance has c = 1 - 2/d: count 12 for d = 3 and 8 for d = 4.
flux_density_statements.label: EXACT

flux_density_statements.statement: Sector law of a cubic complex with the tick as an axis: electric coefficient 2/3 (d = 3) and 1/2 (d = 4).
flux_density_statements.status_here: d = 4 confirmed. d = 3 is 1/3: the electric variance is (1 - Pi)/g^2, Pi = 2/d.
flux_density_statements.label: EXACT

statements.text: <A> equals the ratio of partition functions with the seam's time-like plaquette twisted by the centre element.
statements.label: EXACT

statements.text: One free link in the one-tick thermal law: <A> = M exp(-S) with M = 2 on the Cartan circle and M = 2 (2S - 1) = 150.79 on the full link.
statements.label: EXACT

statements.text: Weight power 1 (one-sided register) and weight power 0 (labels) give power laws at every heat time: 0.0338 and 0.167 at the chain coupling.
statements.label: EXACT

statements.text: Cartan circle on a complex: <A> = 2 exp(-c S), c = 1 - Pi. Cubic lattices: c = 1 - 2/d. Icosahedral space with many ticks: c = 0.398231.
statements.label: EXACT

statements.text: The counts 8/d and the pair weight exp(-2S) are densities of the plaquette flux at a half turn. They are a different object from <A>.
statements.label: EXACT

statements.text: SU(2) heat kernel: c = 0.5001 (0.0008) on the 6^4 lattice, 0.3347 (0.0012) on the 8^3 lattice, 0.3988 (0.0005) on the icosahedral space.
statements.label: MEASURED

statements.text: The measured sector law of the lattice link has weight power 2 and a heat time longer than g^2/2.
statements.label: MEASURED

statements.text: No lattice ensemble measured here has c = 1. The working law is the law of one pinned link: c = 1 holds where the seam's plaquette cannot move.
statements.label: MEASURED

statements.text: The class balance changes across the Higgs line of the gauge-Higgs system: by a factor 0.015 with the heat-kernel weight and 0.18 with the Wilson weight. A stiff doublet pins the link and moves it toward the one-link law.
statements.label: MEASURED

statements.text: Read at the midpoint of the face step the coefficients are 0.70 (three dimensions), 0.74 (icosahedral space) and 1.29 (four dimensions) for the heat kernel. No reading has the coefficient 1.
statements.label: MEASURED

statements.text: The sector law of the seam link that has c = 1 and b M = 1 is not supplied by any lattice ensemble here.
statements.label: MEASURED

statements.text: The tick equals the cell in every lattice here.
statements.label: DECLARED
